.mf-number-ticker { display:inline-block; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap; letter-spacing:-.035em; }
.mf-number-ticker__accessible { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; border:0; }
